text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
H-Hwaaah~...? I woke up. I wonder what 
that dream was just now~...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Rawr~~!! I'm gonna make everyone in this 
town Buono~☆

text_block_list.name: Fleeing Woman
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaah!? R-Run away!! It's "Bonogon, the 
Giant Monster of Happiness"ーー!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Why did I turn into a monster, I wonder~?? 
I don't get the reason at all~???

...Curious about the dream, Hishi Akebono 
couldn't sleep and ended up staying up 
late into the night.
